notes: The tech tree (programme/research.py). cost: science to research it; requires: nodes before it; parts: what it lets the programme build. Free nodes (cost 0, needing nothing) are known from the start. A part in no node is always buildable.

nodes.name: Basic rocketry
nodes.about: A crew capsule on two big kerosene stages, home behind a heat shield under a parachute: Pathfinder.

nodes.name: Side boosters
nodes.about: Strap-on boosters that light with the core and drop away: Pathfinder Heavy's extra 2 km/s.

nodes.name: Small rockets
nodes.about: 1.25 m tanks, engines and separators, adapters, a small heat shield and landing legs: landers and upper stages.

nodes.name: Science instruments
nodes.about: Sample the air and the ground: more science from every place a vessel goes.

nodes.name: Electrics
nodes.about: Battery packs and a small solar wing: flights longer than the capsule's batteries last.

nodes.name: Uncrewed probes
nodes.about: A probe core flown from home through the link, and a medium-gain antenna to reach the inner planets.

nodes.name: Orbital survey
nodes.about: A survey camera that maps the ground from orbit: sharper maps, and science for every percent mapped.

nodes.name: Docking
nodes.about: Docking ports to join vessels in orbit, and a 4 kW solar array.

nodes.name: Storable propellants
nodes.about: Hypergolic tanks and a lander engine: propellants that keep for years, for a long cruise's last burn.

nodes.name: Hydrogen upper stages
nodes.about: Liquid hydrogen: by far the best upper stage (455 s), in big light tanks that boil off in sunlight.

nodes.name: Methane engines
nodes.about: Methane and oxygen: a little better than kerosene, and what a plant can make from Mars's air.

nodes.name: Zero boil-off
nodes.about: Insulated hydrogen tanks and a cryocooler that keeps 15 t from boiling, on 2 kW.

nodes.name: Surface mobility
nodes.about: Wheels and a chassis for rovers, and a rotor and body for a small helicopter (Ingenuity's kind) for thin air.

nodes.name: Deep space communications
nodes.about: A high-gain dish that reaches home from the outer planets.

nodes.name: Space stations
nodes.about: A habitat for four, side ports to build out from, a supply module, and a 28 kW array to run it all.

nodes.name: Nuclear power
nodes.about: A radioisotope generator for where the Sun is weak, and a 10 kW fission reactor.

nodes.name: Living off the land
nodes.about: A propellant plant: land on ice or in Mars's air, refuel and come home.
